data.name: UPI Fraud Flow Tracer — MuleHunter
data.description: Defense-first transaction tracing system that unmasks multi-hop layering and structuring mule accounts across 24-hour windows. Employs bidirectional BFS temporal graph traversal and device-fingerprint linkage to generate deterministic, auditable fraud-risk scores.

data.name: Multimodal Product Price Prediction
data.description: Multimodal pricing engine trained on 150K+ product records for the Amazon ML Challenge 2025. Combines 2048-dimensional visual embeddings extracted via ResNet50 and InceptionV3 with transformer-based NLP text features, optimized through gradient-boosted ensembles to achieve a 39 validation SMAPE.

data.name: OwnChatGPT — Conversational AI Assistant
data.description: Full-stack conversational assistant built on LangGraph ReAct agent workflows and ChromaDB vector retrieval. Delivers real-time Server-Sent Events (SSE) streaming, persistent conversation memory, integrated tool calling, and guided algorithmic code debugging.

data.name: Agentic Blog Studio — LangGraph Multi-Agent Platform
data.description: Multi-agent technical content pipeline coordinating autonomous research, outline synthesis, parallel section drafting, and automated semantic citation validation across structured LangGraph DAG workflows.

data.name: Tata Elxsi TellPORT — Off-Highway Telematics Intelligence
data.description: Edge telematics analytics solution engineered for off-highway vehicles in the Tata Elxsi TELIPORT challenge. Integrates operational sensor data streams with statistical anomaly detection for predictive equipment maintenance.

data.name: ExpenseTracker MCP Server & AI Tool Integration
data.description: Model Context Protocol (MCP) server developed in FastMCP and SQLite, exposing personal expense recording, category queries, and budget summaries directly to Claude Desktop and AI assistants over HTTP/SSE.

data.name: SmartSahaayak — AI Assistant for Small Enterprises
data.description: Mobile-first assistant for local retail store owners, replacing manual bookkeeping with automated daily sales recording, inventory tracking, instant bill generation, and customer balance alerts.

data.name: Clinical Trial Data Quality & Operations Platform
data.description: Centralized operational platform consolidating multi-source Electronic Data Capture (EDC) feeds across clinical trial sites, featuring automated SQL ingestion pipelines and statistical anomaly detection for protocol compliance.

data.name: AI-Driven Biomaterials SEM Analysis & Optimization
data.description: Automated SEM image-analysis pipeline using OpenCV (CLAHE, watershed segmentation) to extract nanorod morphology for 200+ particles/image, coupled with Gaussian Process Bayesian optimization for 3D bioprinting bioinks.

data.name: Personalized Recommendation System — Zomathon
data.description: Data-driven recommendation engine evaluating collaborative filtering and content-based ranking algorithms to predict user food preferences with balanced relevance and recommendation diversity.

data.name: Netflix Catalog Content Analytics
data.description: Comprehensive exploratory SQL analysis of Netflix titles, examining release trends, country-specific catalogs, genre classifications, and creator distribution patterns using advanced window functions.
